## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Barcelona, Spain. It starts at Carrer del Pintor Fortuny, 17.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Everyone has a Sagrada selfie from Barcelona – but not everyone has a T-Rex selfie! Add some spicy photos to your Barcelona itinerary at the Museum of Illusions, and strike a pose next to some of the quirkiest backdrops in town. From famous paintings to UFO abductions, and world-leader toilet humor, this fun attraction will give you some truly unique snaps.
>
> Speaking of fun attractions, you can double up with access to the Big Fun Museum, where even more wacky shenanigans await.
